areas.name: Orders and Delivery Records
areas.location_cue: The Ring Terminal Orders search, facility terminals, SSS messages, and map request markers.
areas.note: No order is permanently missable. Difficulty consistency matters for the all-Standard-Orders maximum-rank milestone.

items.label: Every Main Order

levels.1: Follow only the gold-strand order markers when you want to advance.
levels.2: Complete every Main Order through the campaign.
levels.3: Accept each gold-strand order from its marked terminal and complete the displayed cargo or field objective. Difficulty does not alter campaign completion, and optional cleanup remains available on the completed save.

items.label: Every Sub Order

levels.1: Read SSS posts whenever a facility's star meter stops moving.
levels.2: Complete all twenty-five numbered Sub Orders in Australia.
levels.3: Use the Orders search and every facility terminal to clear Sub Orders 100 through 124. Several unlock optional facilities or release connection caps, so finish them roughly in numerical order, rest or make another delivery when the next message is delayed, and verify all twenty-five show completed.

items.label: Every Standard Order at Maximum Rank

levels.1: The Search tab exposes unfinished destinations and prior evaluations.
levels.2: Complete all four hundred unique Standard Orders with an S evaluation on one consistent difficulty tier.
levels.3: Choose the difficulty whose full milestone you want before serious order cleanup. Search by incomplete evaluation, accept each distinct Standard Order, meet every cargo, damage, quantity, temperature, orientation, time, or combat condition, and earn S. If you later complete even one order on a higher changeable difficulty, the milestone follows that new highest tier and earlier orders must be repeated there; check all four hundred records before changing difficulty.

items.label: Every Offline Aid Request

levels.1: Inspect map speech bubbles and facility request notices while crossing each region.
levels.2: Complete all eighty-eight offline Aid Requests across Mexico and Australia.
levels.3: Open each NPC Aid Request, travel to its marked search or construction zone, recover the full requested cargo, eliminate the full marked group, or place and finish the exact requested structure. Online player requests do not count. Verify the offline Aid Request milestone shows eighty-eight complete.

items.label: Three Standard-Order Categories

levels.1: Start with ten different jobs from each broad objective icon.
levels.2: Earn S on ten unique deliveries, ten recoveries, and ten elimination-or-destruction Standard Orders on Casual or above.
levels.3: Set Casual or higher before acceptance, select ten distinct orders in each of the three categories, and earn S. For cargo jobs, deliver nearly everything with contents and container damage below five percent while satisfying special handling. For combat jobs, minimize all damage from acceptance until reporting back; quick-save immediately after acceptance so a failed attempt does not force a cooldown wait.

save_backup.title: Back up before changing difficulty
save_backup.why: The all-orders milestone tracks the highest changeable difficulty on which any Standard Order receives a result.
save_backup.detail: Keep the cleanup difficulty fixed, and save before accepting difficult elimination or destruction orders.

areas.name: Structures, Roads, and Monorails
areas.location_cue: Connected territory containing PCC build sites, Auto-Pavers, and numbered Tracklayers.
areas.note: Personal construction records require your own placement or material contribution; merely using another player's structure is insufficient.

items.label: Every Structure Type

levels.1: Compare the build wheel with Structure Records rather than trusting shared structures.
levels.2: Personally build and place every structure type once.
levels.3: Create a sign; fabricate and place a climbing anchor, ladder, guidepost, electric trap, and deployable shield; then use PCCs for Postbox, Watchtower, Timefall Shelter, Generator, Bridge, Chiral Bridge, Safe House, Jump Ramp, Zip-line, Transponder, Cargo Catapult, and Hot Spring Digger. Finish your own Bridge and Safe House foundations with materials. Confirm all tracked record slots plus the untracked shield and spring digger.

items.label: Every Australian Road

levels.1: Auto-Pavers trace the paved network across connected sectors.
levels.2: Restore every road segment, then upgrade every segment to Level 2.
levels.3: Connect each surrounding network sector to reduce material requirements, restore every Auto-Paver with chiral crystals, metals, and ceramics, then unlock Level 2 roads at East Fort Knot's second star. Revisit every paver and supply its crystal, chemical, and ceramic upgrade requirement until the road records show both restoration milestones complete.

items.label: All Three Monorail Lines

levels.1: Tracklayers join forts, distribution centers, and the larger mines.
levels.2: Restore all thirty-three Tracklayers across the Northwest, East Coast, and Trans-Crater lines.
levels.3: Repair every Tracklayer from West Fort Knot through F2 to Mine Near F3 Crater; every east-coast section from Northeastern Mine through F4 and Mine North of F6 to F6; and every trans-crater section from F8 through F5 to Mine North of Tar Lake. Supply resins, special alloys, and chiral crystals until all three routes operate end to end.

items.label: Echidna

items.label: Bilby

levels.1: Scan clear ground at night and avoid searching during rain.

levels.1: Scan clear ground at night and avoid searching during rain.

items.label: One Albino Animal

areas.name: Large BT Capture

items.label: Dolphin-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: The BT zones north of The Data Scientist or in either Mexican desert construction area.
levels.3: After the EX Capture Grenade unlocks, let a normal Gazer's Hunter pull you into the encounter, reduce the target until its health is red, throw the capture grenade down its throat, then pick up the white crystal.

items.label: Octopus-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: At the bridge ruins east of The Ghost Hunter or below the cliffs east of The Fisherman.
levels.3: Trigger the bridge-ruins encounter through a Gazer or approach the cliff spawn, lower the target to critical health, land an EX Capture Grenade in its mouth, and collect the resulting crystal.

items.label: Beast-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Near the tar by the Northern Environmental Observatory or inside F3 Crater.
levels.3: Use the single target near the observatory for the cleanest attempt, reduce its health into the red section, capture it through the mouth, and collect the white crystal.

items.label: Hand-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Along the snowy mountain above Mine North of Tar Lake, or in the Mexican desert between C1 South and The Bokka.
levels.3: Approach from the mine side to avoid the most dangerous plain, trigger the encounter, weaken the target, throw the EX Capture Grenade down its throat, then pick up the crystal.

items.label: Ray-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Among the apartment ruins in the lowland linking the eastern observatory with The Chronobiologist, or inside F3 Crater.
levels.3: Use a Gazer near those ruins to enter the encounter, lower the target to critical health without finishing it, capture through the mouth, and recover the white crystal.

items.label: Titan-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Inside F3 Crater after the Ghost Hunter's final request is complete.
levels.3: Finish the Ghost Hunter chain first, revisit F3 Crater until this type spawns, reduce its health to red, use the EX Capture Grenade on its mouth, and collect the crystal. Its earlier one-time encounter need not be used.

items.label: Whale-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Inside F3 Crater after the Fisherman's final request is complete.
levels.3: Finish the Fisherman chain to add this type to the crater pool, revisit until it appears, weaken it to critical health, capture it through the mouth, and collect the crystal.

items.label: Crab-Type Large BT

levels.1: After the capture tool unlocks, revisit marked BT zones and the large central crater.
levels.2: Inside F3 Crater after completing the campaign encounter that unlocks its rematch.
levels.3: Return to F3 Crater after campaign completion, wait for this type to spawn, reduce its health into the red section, land an EX Capture Grenade in its mouth, and collect the white crystal.

areas.name: Completion Records
areas.location_cue: The Social Strand Service milestones, APAS menu, training room, fabrication terminals, garages, and private-room customization screens.
areas.note: Use the in-game milestone screen as the final authority; these records include unlock, fabrication, training, consumption, and grade requirements.

items.label: All Five Biote Species

levels.1: Try each differently named biote rather than treating them as interchangeable healing items.
levels.2: Eat one Cryptobiote, Electrobiote, Chlorobiote, Chronobiote, and Necrobiote.
levels.3: Acquire each species from its matching habitat or facility route, select it from the usable-item menu, and consume at least one. Check the biote milestone after all five distinct names have registered.

items.label: Every APAS Enhancement

levels.1: Porter grades and facility stars unlock nodes in several APAS branches.
levels.2: Develop all forty-eight APAS enhancements.
levels.3: Raise every facility to five stars and improve all five porter grades, then open APAS Enhancements and activate every unlocked node across Porter, Combat, Stealth, Servicemanship, and Bridge Link. Recheck after BPAS and The Metagenomicist reach their final stars; their late nodes are common blockers.

items.label: All Firing-Range Drills

levels.1: New equipment adds programs to the training menu.
levels.2: Complete all twenty-two VR Training drills at least once.
levels.3: Use the training menu aboard the mobile base or from a private-room weapon display, unlock missing drills through equipment progression, and finish every program once. S rank is not required for this completion milestone.

items.label: All Strange-Realm Drills

levels.1: A second training group appears after the laboratory joins the network.
levels.2: Complete all three strange-realm replay drills once.
levels.3: After connecting Heartman's Lab, open VR Training from the mobile base or a private room and finish each of the three replay programs. Any clear rank is sufficient.

items.label: All Fabricable Equipment Unlocked

levels.1: Five-star connections expose the last fabrication plans.
levels.2: Unlock all ninety-five equipment types.
levels.3: Complete every Main and Sub Order, maximize all facilities, and claim each connection reward. Open Fabricate Equipment and compare the available entries with the equipment milestone until all ninety-five types are unlocked; fabrication is separate from unlocking unless another record explicitly asks for it.

items.label: Every Vehicle Customization Fabricated

levels.1: A plan does not count until it has been installed once.
levels.2: Fabricate all seventeen vehicle customizations.
levels.3: After all facilities reach five stars, open vehicle customization at a garage and fabricate every body, tire, armor, battery, and weapon configuration represented by a separate milestone entry. Apply each once and verify all seventeen records are filled.

items.label: Every Backpack Customization Fabricated

levels.1: Inspect each backpack category after every facility reward.
levels.2: Fabricate all twenty-one backpack customizations.
levels.3: At a private-room backpack menu, fabricate and install every distinct battery, pouch, stabilizer, utility, and accessory entry once. Recheck after all five-star facility rewards, then verify twenty-one customization records.

items.label: Porter Grade 40 in Every Category

levels.1: The five-color star grows through different kinds of play.
levels.2: Reach grade 40 in Porter, Combat, Stealth, Servicemanship, and Bridge Link.
levels.3: Use heavy intact deliveries for Porter; defeat enemies for Combat; recover hostile cargo or disable targets without detection for Stealth; build, repair, and fulfill requests for Servicemanship; and use shared systems, likes, and aid for Bridge Link. Check each arm of the profile star and continue its matching activity until all five display 40 or higher.

areas.name: Campaign and Post-Campaign
areas.location_cue: The marked Main Order list and the unrestricted completed-save map.
areas.note: There are no permanent missables and no lasting point of no return; temporary travel locks clear with progress, and all optional content remains available afterward.

items.label: Campaign Completion

levels.1: Continue the marked Main Orders when ready to advance.
levels.2: Complete the campaign on any difficulty and load the completed save.
levels.3: Follow the gold-strand Main Orders at your own pace. After campaign completion, load the completed save and use unrestricted free roam for all remaining orders, connections, records, and infrastructure.

items.label: Post-Campaign Facility Interaction

levels.1: One optional terminal has an additional interaction only after the campaign.
levels.2: With the Drawbridge Q-pid enabled, revisit The Ghost Hunter's terminal after campaign completion.
levels.3: Load the completed save, ensure the Drawbridge Q-pid is enabled in the Ring Terminal, travel to The Ghost Hunter, and interact with the terminal. If access is blocked during other cleanup, toggle the Q-pid only as the current order or terminal requires and try again.

items.label: Final Milestone Audit

levels.1: The Social Strand Service shows exactly which completion category remains unfinished.
levels.2: Finish all eighteen completion milestones and every finite completion action in this pack.
levels.3: Open the milestone and records screens and verify: every facility is connected and five-starred; all species, biotes, APAS nodes, orders, Aid Requests, drills, roads, monorails, mines, springs, equipment plans, vehicle parts, and backpack parts are complete. Then verify the remaining one-time construction, rank, rare-animal, capture, and optional-order actions in this guide.

save_backup.title: Keep a separate completion save
save_backup.why: Major campaign transitions can temporarily narrow travel, although they do not erase optional content.
save_backup.detail: The backup is only a progress-safety copy; cleanup remains available later.

areas.name: Optional Encounters and Hidden Interactions
areas.location_cue: Unmarked shorelines, roadside formations, facility message chains, and late-network wilderness.
areas.note: These discoveries are optional and are described by geography and mechanics rather than story context.

items.label: Terminal Emergency Prevention

levels.1: One late terminal has an avoidable environmental failure state.
levels.2: Advance The Ghost Hunter to its fourth connection tier, then take the next sub order to the shore by Terminal Fort Knot.
levels.3: Complete Sub Orders 111, 112, and 113 while raising The Ghost Hunter, then fill level four until the message for Sub Order 114 arrives. Bring launchers, a machine gun, blood supplies, and EX Capture Grenades to the marked shoreline. Walk into the broken structures in the tar, defeat the large humanoid BT, or capture it after its health turns red, and report back to The Ghost Hunter.

items.label: Headless-Rider Formation Riddle

levels.1: A night-only vehicle request opens an unusual elevated-road battle.
levels.2: After Sub Order 109, take Sub Order 110, arrive east of The Ghost Hunter at night, and bring a Tri-Cruiser.
levels.3: Finish Sub Order 109 from The Chronobiologist, accept Sub Order 110 from The Ghost Hunter, and travel east after dark on a Tri-Cruiser. Ride into the red-lit Auto-Paver marker, defeat the attacking Ghost Mech bikes while circling the floating road, then destroy the tougher final bike and return the order.

items.label: Tar-Lake Optional Encounter

levels.1: A large tar basin supports a fight that normal deliveries never require.
levels.2: Raise The Fisherman almost through connection level five and accept Sub Order 117.
levels.3: After The Fisherman's level-five meter stops near its end, read the new message and accept Sub Order 117. levels.2: Raise The Pizza Chef until level two stops progressing, then search the nearby enemy camps after Main Order 29.
levels.3: After Main Order 29, search the camp northeast of The Pizza Chef and the camp south of the desert east of The Data Scientist for Pizza Chef's Misanga.
